basics.name: Amy Fan
basics.label: Server Systems Software Engineer
basics.summary: Server Systems Software Engineer on the Operational Data Platform team at Epic Systems. MS in Statistics and Data Science, University of Arizona.

education.area: Statistics and Data Science, Computational Biology

work.name: Epic Systems
work.position: Server Systems Software Engineer, Operational Data Platform
highlights: Developed Go+Gin and Ruby on Rails REST APIs and a React/TypeScript portal for VM fleets, used by 10+ teams.
Owned reliability/security foundations: failover design, observability, credentials + OAuth2 pipeline for service backends.
Automated authentication-key selection for privileged workflows, cutting average time from 36 minutes to 1 minute per run.
Led identification and remediation of a configuration vulnerability that enabled OS shell/config overrides; shipped a hardening change enforcing secure defaults for all customers.
Provision and troubleshoot customer environments (staging/prod): bootstrap SFTP/SMTP, MFT/NAS integrations, rclone-based transfers, and validate via UAT.

work.name: University of Arizona - Capaldi Lab
highlights: Architected multi-GPU Mask R-CNN pipelines for noisy microscopy data with custom PyTorch Lightning dataloaders.
Demonstrated feasibility of low-light microscopy instance segmentation: achieved 85% mAP/IoU under low-light conditions, within ~5% of reported well-lit SOTA (~87-90%).
Thesis: full text (UArizona Repository) · Code: CellSeg-MaskRCNN

projects.name: Kubernetes Secret Rotation Operator
projects.summary: Java 21 Kubernetes operator (Java Operator SDK, fabric8) with a level-triggered reconciler managing a custom RotatingSecret CRD; generates credentials via SecureRandom, writes to native Secrets with owner references for cascade deletion, and requeues itself for the next rotation.
highlights: Instrumented with Micrometer/Prometheus (rotation count + staleness gauge per resource) via Spring Boot Actuator.
Packaged as a Helm chart; CI publishes image to ghcr.io via GitHub Actions.

projects.name: URL Shortener
projects.summary: URL shortener REST API (FastAPI, Pydantic) containerized with Docker, pushed to AWS ECR, and deployed on ECS EC2; selected DynamoDB as backing store after evaluating access patterns (pure key-value, no joins required).
highlights: Provisioned full AWS infrastructure with Terraform: custom VPC, subnets, Internet Gateway, route tables, security groups, ECS cluster, ECR repository, and DynamoDB table.
Applied least-privilege IAM: separated ECS execution role (ECR pull) from task role scoped to DynamoDB GetItem/PutItem on a single table ARN; validated with a pytest suite.

projects.name: Eyem Watching You - Eye Tracking to Mousepad
projects.summary: Real-time eye-tracking mouse controller: extracted pupil landmarks (OpenCV/dlib), ran multithreaded calibration + capture, and applied polynomial smoothing for stable cursor control. Won Best Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at MLH Open Source Hackfest, October 2024.
highlights: Developed a Flask web UI and packaged the application for distribution; deployed the web experience using Defang.
